verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is a platform where agents run. Shipping a built-in assistant is plausible for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only secure environments for executing agent code and an example of a developer building an LLM coding agent. These are developer building blocks, not a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
